name: sandbox_run_status
description: State of a sandbox_run: ACCEPTED (being started), RUNNING (started; a GUI program stays here while open), SUCCEEDED or FAILED (ended; exit_code and stdout from the Sandbox's checked receipt), DENIED (not started), HELD (its result could not pass the Host's checks) or UNKNOWN (it may have run; never run it again to find out). Calling it again is safe.
